answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 2010 Country: DE Title: Is it allowed for us to pray in between the pillars in the mosque? Question: Is it allowed for us to pray in between the pillars in the mosque? Answer ID: 2010 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 512/512=L) It is in the book Shami: والأصح ما روی عن أبی حنیفۃ أنہ قال: أکرہ أن یقوم بین الساریتین . This indicates that it is makrooh (undesirable) to stand for salah between two pillars. Also, there are some traditions which say that the Sahaba ( رضی اللہ عنھم ) used to avoid standing between two pillars in salah . ( کما فی اعلاء السنن 4/237، ط پاکستان ) So, it was known that it is makrooh (undesirable) to stand for salah between two pillars without any need. Yes, it is allowable when there are some people (more than one) who can stand there: والاصطفاف بین الأسطوانتین غیر مکروہ لأنہ صف فی حق کل فریق وان لم یکن طویلا و تخلل الأسطوانۃ بین الصف کتخلل متاع موضوع أو کفرجۃ بین رجلین و ذلک لایمنع صحۃ الاقتداء ولایوجب الکراھۃ (المبسوط للسرخسی: 2/35، ط مصر) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
